The Hague: English-taught master's €14,000

At The Hague UAS, the general non-EU fee is €10,528 and a full-time English-taught master's is €14,000 (2026/27). Non-EU applications close on 1 May. Your file must be complete by 15 June. 2027 dates have not been updated yet.

Source: thuas.com (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Oxford 2027 entry: UCAS closed on 15 October 2026

The UCAS deadline for Oxford 2027 entry was 15 October 2026 at 18:00. Fees for 2026 entry are £37,380-£62,820 by subject. Confirm the 2027 fee. Clinical years cost more. Most EU students pay the same too.

Source: ox.ac.uk, assets-oxweb.admin.ox.ac.uk (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Harvard does not require TOEFL

For first-year applications to Harvard College, an English test is optional, not required. The SAT or ACT is required, with limited exceptions. Not required doesn't mean the score doesn't matter. The decision is entirely Harvard's.

Source: college.harvard.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
